test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**all**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence describes the villagers' routine: "Villagers wake up to roosters crowing and farm (2)_____ day."
 
• The phrase "farm all day" is a common idiom meaning to work on the farm for the entire duration of the day, from morning till evening. This fits the context of agricultural life in villages.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Indian villages showcase the country's rich culture and customs. Most Indians live in villages, (1) **where** __agriculture, modest living and close-knit communities are the norms. Villagers wake up to roosters crowing and farm 2. __all__ day. Farming is the main employment, and generations labour (3)____ the same land. Traditions, communal events and a slower pace (4)_____ village life from metropolitan life. Villagers' togetherness and shared duty make it part of India's identity, (5)_____ the lack of contemporary conveniences.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Towards**: "Farm towards day" doesn't make sense grammatically or contextually. "Towards" indicates direction.
 
• **Before**: "Farm before day" would mean they farm before the day begins, which is illogical in this context as farming is a daytime activity.
 
• **After**: "Farm after day" would mean they farm once the day is over, which is also illogical for typical farming work.
